notes.flutter: Stable SDK used by CI, local gates and Xcode Cloud; verified with flutter --version.
notes.dart: Bundled with the pinned Flutter SDK; verified with dart --version.
notes.ndk: Flutter 3.47.8 defaults to this NDK. CI, Gradle and the core scripts must use the same one.
notes.cmake: SDK manager component installed by the Android CI legs.
notes.xcode_minimum: Floor already used by the Podfile, the iOS core scripts and the platform matrix.
notes.ios_deployment_target: Deployment floor for the app and every iOS core.
notes.mingw: Minimum GCC in the MSYS2 UCRT64 toolchain used by the Windows CI leg; that leg prints the installed compiler.
notes.llvm_mingw: Baseline for the Windows-on-Linux cross build; no leg consumes this pin yet.
notes.msvc: Visual Studio generation on the Windows runner; no leg consumes this pin yet.
